subject: Leadership roundup: wins, top risks, and QBR inputs (week of Mar 22-29)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership roundup: wins, top risks, and QBR inputs (week of Mar 22-29)

Team — attaching a concise pack of items for the exec QBR next Tuesday. Below are the high-level wins, the top two risks I want us to track, and specific asks (owners + by-when). Please review and reply with any corrections or additional asks by EOD Monday so I can fold into the final deck.

WINS (quick bullets):
- Hosted API: 12% latency improvement after rolling kernel patch (production on 3/24). Measured 95th percentile drop from 430ms -> 380ms for our 8k seq profile.
- Dedicated: Closed first 12-month reserved-capacity deal with Acme Corp — signed and PR raised. Estimated $1.1M ARR. (Aditya + Markus)
- Optimize: Early results from prefix-caching pilot show 18% token-cost reduction for one major customer workload.

TOP RISKS + MITIGATION:
1) Risk: SOC 2 evidence gap for VPC audit trails (customer ask during procurement). Impact: potential delay for two mid-market deals.
   Mitigation owner: Evelyn — provide audit extract and intake window by Thu 3/30.
2) Risk: Canary rollout for quantized 4-bit builds causing rare hallucination regression on domain prompts (internal eval flagged).
   Mitigation owner: Engineering (Jonas + Markus) — pause wider canary, push hotfix by Mon 3/29, expand eval prompt set.

ASKS (clear and short):
- Aditya: include Acme contact quote and next-steps slide for QBR (deliverable: 1 slide, due Mon 3/29 COB).
- Laura: build one-slide risk heatmap that includes SOC 2 and quantization regression (due Mon 3/29 noon).
- Markus: confirm rollout plan and provide short note we can read in the QBR about the kernel patch and rollback policy (due Mon 3/29 afternoon).
- Evelyn: attach SOC 2 audit window evidence (pdf) and short note on expected remediation timeline (due Thu 3/30).

Attachments: QBR_input_matrix_2026Q1.xlsx (tracking owners/due dates), customer_escalation_timeline.pdf (Acme).

I'll consolidate replies into the final QBR appendix. If you want to push anything into the 'highlights' slide rather than appendix, flag it here.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Product & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership roundup: wins, top risks, and QBR inputs (week of Mar 22-29)

Thanks — solid outline. A couple of notes:
- I'll take the risk heatmap. I'll include a brief callout on customer impact bands (High/Med/Low) and the mitigation confidence levels.
- For the highlighted wins, suggest we front-load the kernel patch impact on the performance slide — it's tangible and resonates with platform customers.

One quick ask back at you: can we get a one-line customer quote from Acme (Aditya) to use on the wins slide? If not, I'll keep the win quantitative-only.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership roundup: wins, top risks, and QBR inputs (week of Mar 22-29)

On it — I have Acme's procurement contact (Anna) on standby; she said a short quote is OK and we'll request approval today. I'll drop the approved quote into the drive and add a 1-slide Acme summary by COB Mon.

Also flagging one detail: Acme asked about SSO integration timelines (they're evaluating Dedicated). Evelyn — can you confirm whether we can offer a customer-scoped timeline for SSO setup next week? That will be a gating item for their launch date planning.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership roundup: wins, top risks, and QBR inputs (week of Mar 22-29)

Thanks Jonas. Quick status on the canary regression:
- Root cause appears to be an interaction between the 4-bit quant path and a prompt-tokenization edge case for a customer domain. We've reproduced internally on a small eval set.
- Plan: pause broader canary, push a micro-fix to quantization pipeline by Mon morning, expand eval prompts to include domain-specific samples. If all clear, gradual resume on Tuesday.

I'll write the rollout blurb for the deck and include the rollback thresholds (95th-pct latency increase >10% or regression F1 drop >2 pts triggers immediate rollback).

— Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Serving Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership roundup: wins, top risks, and QBR inputs (week of Mar 22-29)

Jonas/Aditya — I can produce an audit extract for the VPC trails and a short remediation timeline. Two items:
1) The extract will show gaps across a 30-day window for one onboarding pipeline (we're missing consolidated logs from a legacy agent). We should be transparent in the QBR appendix.
2) Estimate to ship the consolidated trail within 3 weeks if we prioritize it (requires a small infra sprint).

I'll attach a preliminary PDF of the extract and timeline (customer_escalation_timeline.pdf) and will confirm the final artifact by Thu 3/30.

— Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2026 17:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership roundup: wins, top risks, and QBR inputs (week of Mar 22-29)

Thanks all — closing the loop:
- Laura: noted for the heatmap (thx).
- Aditya: agreed on the Acme quote; I'll include a callout about SSO as a follow-up item in the notes.
- Markus: thanks for the canary plan. Please confirm Monday AM when the micro-fix is pushed; we'll mark that as 'mitigated' in the QBR if green by Tue.
- Evelyn: received the attachment and timeline — I'll include the transparency note in the appendix and mark remediation as 'in progress'.

I consolidated the slide set (see link). If no objections, I'll mark the closes and move to the highlights/deck-level points for the QBR. Small ask: if you added items to the drive, please mark the QBR_input_matrix row as DONE so I can finalize.

Final: attaching the consolidated tracking sheet (QBR_input_matrix_2026Q1.xlsx).

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, Product & Ops
Redwood Inference
